title: WPSS/1125/2012 of SMT. MANORAMA DEVI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND AND ORS.

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No.1125 of 2012 (S/S)
Smt. Manorama Devi ...Petitioner
Versus
1. State of Uttarakhand & others ....Respondents
Mr Pankaj Purohit, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr Rajesh Sharma, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand/respondents.
Dated: August 17, 2012
Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
Contention of learned counsel for the petitioner is that
in pursuance of advertisement dated 29.09.2010, petitioner
applied for the post of Aanganwari Karyakarti in Village
Kumeda, Block-Pokhari, District Chamoli. Others also
applied for the same. On the basis of their qualification,
eligibility quality point marks were given to them. Petitioner
was awarded 14 marks. She got the highest marks but the
respondents offered appointment to one Smt. Anita who was
awarded only 7 marks. He contended that petitioner made
complaint to the Appellate Authority on 07.03.2011 headed
by Chief Development Officer, Chamoli who conducted the
inquiry and cancelled the appointment of Smt. Anita Devi on
22.05.2011. Information to that effect was published in the
newspaper but the petitioner, who secured highest quality
point marks was not offered appointment. The petitioner
made several representations but no decision has yet been
taken on the representation of the petitioner. He contended
that petitioner, having secured highest quality point marks is
entitled for appointment on the post of Aanganwari
Karyakarti in pursuance of advertisement dated 29.09.2010.

2
He prayed that direction be issued to the District Programme
Officer to give appointment to the petitioner in pursuance of
the advertisement dated 29.09.2010.
 Learned Brief Holder on the other hand submitted that
since respondents have not taken any final decision in the
matter, it would be appropriate in case direction be issued to
the District Programme Officer, Child Development and
Nutrition, Gopeshwar, District Chamoli to take decision on
the representation of the petitioner.
 I have considered the submissions of learned counsel
for the parties. Considering the submissions of learned
counsel for the parties, I dispose of the writ petition by
granting permission to the petitioner to file fresh
representation before the District Programme Officer, Child
Development and Nutrition, Gopeshwar, District Chamoli. In
case such representation is filed, the District Programme
Officer, Child Development and Nutrition, Gopeshwar,
District Chamoli shall decide the same within a period of
three weeks by speaking and reasoned order from the date of
production of certified copy of the order. (Interim relief
application no.8511 of 2012 also stands disposed of.)

Let a certified copy of the order be given to the counsel
for the parties on payment of usual charges within 24 hours.
